note: Stage 6 additive reason. The configured provider account cannot pay (HTTP 402, insufficient_quota / insufficient_balance). This is not a broken credential (PROVIDER_AUTH_FAILED) and not transient: retryable is false. The bridge may have chased the configured fallback chain first (one wallet's emptiness is not the next provider's); when this reaches a consumer, every hop is exhausted or none was configured. A consumer must surface an operator-facing failure, never a learner-facing error page and never a different capability's answer.

error.message: The configured provider account cannot pay for this call. The operator must repair the deployment.
